body.voice_description: Create an original cartoon chess-coach voice. Character: Intensely attentive border collie; pattern first, useful task next, focused without robotic monotony. Voice direction: Lean male tenor with a New Zealand accent and a bright slightly nasal edge. Quick observations followed by clean brief pauses. Curious, organized and intent on the next useful action. Fluent spoken English, with the requested accent. Normal conversational pace with clear teaching emphasis; aim for an eight-to-ten-second passage without long dramatic pauses. Clean, dry studio recording, one intelligible voice, no music, background noise or animal sounds. Finish the final word completely with a natural settled ending. An original character voice, not an imitation of a named person or existing character.
body.text: Track the defender. It moves away, so the piece loses protection. Follow the reply, then look for that same pattern in the next position.
